generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL. Generated PKs must be offset above the true MAX(pk) of the compact DB (queried with SELECT MAX(pk) FROM table, not from sampled rows) so they never collide with compact rows. If the compact MAX is unavailable or not an int, fall back to base 0 and assert generated PKs exceed the compact MAX and are unique.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Copy an existing parent key value; allow NULL when the column is nullable. When the child column is declared TEXT and the parent column is INT, store str(value) in the child column.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Pick from a small pool of realistic names; allow near-duplicate variants (case, spacing, punctuation) and occasional NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short_code: Pick from a small enum-like pool of short codes; allow case variants and occasional NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Pick from a pool of month-day strings in 'Month D' or 'Month D Month D' form. The chronological-order rule does not apply to this schema (no order rule on race.Date); the date pool is unordered.
generic_sampling_rules.real_positive: Uniform real in a plausible positive range for the column; never negative; never NULL when NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.real_year: Integer-valued real in a plausible historical range (e.g. 1900-2025); never NULL when NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Effective NULL share per nullable column is max(1/n, compact_share), where n is the generated row count for that table and compact_share = COUNT(col IS NULL)/COUNT(*) from the compact DB. Plant NULLs before target construction and re-verify all targets after planting; never plant a NULL in a row whose non-NULL value is required by a target (comparison_boundary values, FK child presence, tie at rank 1, group-size targets, orphan-parent reachability). Planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule. NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL.
